🚀 Master Delta Lake & Azure Databricks Like a Pro!
Are you working with Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, or PySpark? Here are the key concepts you need to know to optimize your data workflows:
🔹 Unity Catalog – Simplify data governance and streamline access control.
🔹 ACID Transactions in Delta Lake – Ensure data integrity with reliable transactions.
🔹 External vs. Managed Delta Tables – Understand the differences and know when to use each.
🔹 Optimization Techniques in Databricks – Improve query performance and reduce costs.
🔹 Structured Streaming with PySpark – Efficiently process real-time data with ease.
🔹 Delta Live Tables (ETL Pipelines) – Automate and streamline your ETL workflows for maximum efficiency.
💡 Whether building scalable pipelines or optimizing big data workloads, mastering these concepts will take your data engineering skills to the next level!
